title: Concept: Dependency declared with a four-part version
description: package.json declares a four-part version, which is not a semantic version, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Resolvers disagree about how the fourth component orders, so the version that installs can differ between npm, a mirror and a CI cache.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through package.json (npm).
risk: Resolvers disagree about how the fourth component orders, so the version that installs can differ between npm, a mirror and a CI cache.
